CANONICAL_NAME.value: evomerge -- Evolutionary Optimization of Model Merging Recipes (authors: 'Sakana AI' per pyproject.toml; no author names in README/CITATION; Sakana AI; 2024)

value.lineage: README: source models for the merges are shisa-gamma-7b-v1, WizardMath-7B-V1.1, GAIR/Abel-7B-002, Arithmo2-Mistral-7B, LLaVA-1.6-Mistral-7B; EvoLLM-JP-v1-10B is built from EvoLLM-JP-v1-7B + shisa-gamma-7b-v1. 'Our math evaluation code builds on the WizardMath repository.' evomerge/utils.py functions 'copied from https://github.com/Stability-AI/generative-models'. Vendored heron/video_blip modules carry HuggingFace/Salesforce headers. Compared against lm-eval-harness jp-stable branch (Stability-AI). || main loop (reader, from the code): evaluate.py loads a config, instantiates one model wrapper, then for each evaluator config instantiates the evaluator, calls evaluator(model) to generate answers over a HuggingFace dataset and score them, and dumps all metrics to a JSON file; there is NO evolutionary search, merging (no CMA-ES, DARE, TIES, SLERP, layer-stacking) or optimisation code anywhere in the tree -- the repo is evaluation-only, and the evolved weights are consumed as pre-built HuggingFace checkpoints.
